cards.title: Four laps from the flag, this race flipped
cards.text: Verstappen was already out. Hamilton was chasing a home podium. And then the Safety Car lights came on. 232 overtakes say this was no Sunday drive... scroll and watch it unfold.

cards.title: Antonelli starts from pole, in Hamilton's backyard. Does he still lead after lap 1?
Lights out
cards.text: Antonelli took pole by 0.175s the day before. That is less time than a single blink. It bought him exactly one racing lap of peace: by the end of lap 1, Leclerc was the name on top.

cards.title: 51 overtakes on this lap alone
cards.text: The lead group swapped places 18 times today. Your TV feed showed a fraction of that. The one doing most of the passing: Sainz, 19 moves all afternoon.

cards.title: One stop, and everyone knew it
cards.text: Soft, medium, hard: all three compounds saw track today, and almost everyone got away with a single stop. Fastest trip down the pit lane, entry to exit: Russell, 28.3s. When nobody gains anything in the pits, track position becomes the whole game... remember that when the Safety Car shows up later.

cards.title: Antonelli: 91.777s
cards.text: The kid who started from pole answered his critics with the fastest lap of the day, 91.777s around Silverstone in a Mercedes. Keep his name handy.

cards.title: Verstappen's Sunday ends early
cards.text: His car rolled to a stop on lap 47 and that was that. Also out today: Albon, Hulkenberg. Zero points weekends are where title fights quietly bleed.

cards.title: Every gap on track, erased
cards.text: Four laps from home, the Safety Car wiped out every second anyone had built all afternoon. It pulled in on lap 51... and came straight back out again. The race finished with the field packed nose to tail and Sainz under investigation for a Safety Car infringement. Silverstone got its money's worth.

cards.title: Colapinto: P19 on the grid, P9 at the flag
cards.text: 10 positions gained, one overtake at a time, most of them nowhere near a TV camera. His last pass came on lap 49. Nobody will open the sports pages with Colapinto tomorrow. They probably should.

cards.title: Leclerc wins it
cards.text: Leclerc brings his Ferrari home first, ahead of Russell. And P3, in front of his own grandstand, at home: Hamilton. Listen to that crowd.

cards.title: Won on the lap nobody was watching the clock
cards.text: Race rating: coming with v1's spoiler-free formula.
